name: @arena/runtime-host
description: Arena durable host runtime interface package (Work Order P002; issue #154; ADR-P001-01/02/07). The FROZEN composition-root contract surface: host lifecycle (construct/start/stop), health/readiness, the injected port contracts as pure data (Clock, job store, event sink, escalation store, webhook outbox — A015 law: no I/O in the interface package), the structural service surfaces the host composes (escalation lifecycle, shared durable job runner), the canonical demo/customer truth lens (ADR-P001-02) and the registered host job kinds (ADR-P001-01 recompute/projection/retention-sweep; ADR-P001-06 learning-candidate projection).
